Swedish of When You Wish Upon a Star (Pinocchio, 1940; lyric S.S. Wilson / Anita Halldén). Venue filed Julsång because that Halldén lyric is what Bengt Feldreich sings as Jiminy in Kalle Anka och hans vänner önskar God Jul — Christmas here is that TV association, not a separate carol. The 1941 Swedish Pinocchio dub used a different lyric (När en önskestjärna tänds). First record of this title is Sven-Olof Sandberg, Feb 1941 (SMDB); the 1995 dub is Bertil Engh. No single karaoke performer to invent. Year 1940 from the Pinocchio song (Wikipedia; Visarkiv sheet music).
